propositions: Rebar requires a native Bedrock provider builder that constructs BedrockConverseModel without an OpenAI-compatible gateway, enabling first-class Bedrock support with prompt caching measured on real AWS.

Prompt caching on Bedrock requires exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, and rebar must warn when caching is requested but both cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens remain zero despite nonzero input_tokens.

Temperature parameter is rejected with HTTP 400 on some Bedrock model IDs (e.g. us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7) while supported on others (e.g. us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6), requiring a per-model capability override table keyed on exact model ID rather than profile shape.

The Bedrock builder must authenticate through the ambient AWS credential chain (instance role in production, AWS_PROFILE locally) with no rebar-managed keys, and live in a separate module (bedrock_model.py) to avoid exceeding the 300-LOC cap on providers.py.
Missing boto3 imports must raise clear LLMConfigError naming the required install command (pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]), and boto3 must remain absent from the default [agents] install.

HTTP 400 errors mentioning sampling parameters and rejection keywords must be translated to actionable LLMConfigError exceptions naming the model ID, offending parameter, and both remedies, without swallowing unrelated 400s.
